title: Disk almost full alert flapping on a log server
symptoms: Disk /var/log on logs-01 is 95% full, resolves a few minutes later, then fires again. Seen 6 or more times over the last hour: the DiskAlmostFull alert keeps flapping between firing and resolved. Usage goes up and down like a saw-tooth instead of growing steadily.
root_cause: Logs grow quickly between cleanup runs, so usage repeatedly crosses the alert threshold and drops back. The disk is too small for the log volume.
impact: Alert fatigue: the same alert pages again and again. A real disk-full can hide among the flaps. Risk of hitting 100% if cleanup is late once.
fix_steps: Check the cleanup/logrotate schedule and make it run more often or delete more aggressively.
Find which service writes the most logs and lower its log level if it is too verbose.
Add a 'for: 10m' clause to the alert rule so short spikes do not fire.
Grow the volume if the real log volume needs more space.
prevention: Size disks for peak log volume, use hysteresis or 'for' durations on alerts, and centralize logs.
